evidence: commit a418ef67 swapped dim_branch for raw.branches in fct_payments join
raw.branches holds 14 weekly snapshots per branch_code -> join fan-out
fct_payments 2026-11-04: 3708 rows vs 270 distinct payment_id; earlier partitions 1:1
revert commit b88962f5, rebuild 2026-11-04: 270 rows/270 distinct, mart_delinquency at 2026-11-04
input.summary: Commit a418ef67 (made 2026-11-04) changed fct_payments to join raw.branches directly instead of dim_branch. raw.branches keeps every weekly snapshot (14 per branch), so each payment matched 14 rows. That caused 3708 rows instead of 270, a failed unique payment_id test, a failed dbt_build so mart_delinquency was stale, and the volume alert. I reverted the commit (b88962f5) and rebuilt partition 2026-11-04: fct_payments now has 270 unique rows, mart_delinquency is current, and all alerts have cleared. Only 2026-11-04 was affected. The author's goal of removing the one-run region lag should be redone by joining the latest snapshot or deduplicating.
